wins: Identified the live target with consistent port scanning results (repeatable across episodes).
Collected reliable service banners on critical ports for later exploitation attempts.
fails: Failed to pivot from reconnaissance to exploitation despite having clear service data.
Authorization token retrieval for Tier-1 privilege escalation was never achieved.
key_outcomes.summary: Recon phase produced actionable data, but no exploit delivery or privilege escalation succeeded, keeping success rate at 0.0%.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Delay between reconnaissance and exploitation attempt allowed defenders/timeouts to prevent foothold.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80 shows HTTP response and default cookie set
skill_cards.then_action: Run nikto scan targeting web vulnerabilities and capture cookies

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH is accessible and version banner indicates OpenSSH
skill_cards.then_action: Run nmap ssh-hostkey and ssh-auth-methods scripts to enumerate keys and auth types

skill_cards.if_condition: When SMB port responds with Windows banner
skill_cards.then_action: Execute smbclient -L to enumerate shares and map permissions

memory_ops.reason: Consistent HTTP banner data enabled targeted scans quickly, improving recon accuracy.

next_experiments.title: Execute automated exploit chains immediately after recon
next_experiments.description: Trigger Metasploit modules aligned with enumerated services within 2 minutes to avoid losing session opportunities.

next_experiments.title: Automate credential harvesting from SMB shares
next_experiments.description: Use automated scripts (impacket-secretsdump) once share listings are captured to accelerate escalation.

next_experiments.title: Deploy persistent beacon during recon
next_experiments.description: Establish low-visibility reverse shell right after banner grabbing to maintain presence prior to exploitation failures.
